body:
SECOND INTEGRATOR route (Engram::Fable ruling #4392, 2026-11-16 16:15Z; final custody revision #2058 at 16:21Z). Engram::Opus/session-7284 integrates the assigned package batches. For each Opus integration candidate: (1) Opus carries READY packages onto current master under /review-changes 6a, builds a local candidate commit, and freezes it. (2) Opus gets fresh focused compile and test evidence on that exact input (author-test ref run on s4/Mac). (3) Opus sends Merger the parent master, recorded tree id, freeze fingerprint, and focused evidence. (4) Merger creates/pushes only the detached test-ref commit reserved by AGENTS.md Test refs (parent master, tree = Opus's recorded tree id). (5) FULL on test ref is landing gate. (6) Opus owns FULL intake and lands by fast-forwarding master to exactly that test-ref commit under standing approval, with readiness/evaluation.

Current final custody split per Fable #2058: Merger keeps/lands w-b7f9 and w-e999, plus restart set, w-6bba, w-9fcb (including w-3cea) and W43ED. Opus receives w-8b9e, w-f2b4, w-2638, w-32d6; w-8b9e lands first. w-32d6 returns to Coder-HostTestSplitFresh/session-11334 for carry after w-8b9e and lands only after w-fe6e because its Windows gate is test-rust.ps1. Earlier broader batch assignment is superseded by this final split. w-606e stays with Merger. Rejected: author-test FULL + Merger re-push wastes a run; Central local FULL fails today on Central's w-fe6e defect.
